verdict.rationale: Datadog documents "Bits AI" as a built-in AI assistant, which is directly relevant to delegating tasks inside the product, but the evidence pack gives only a bare doc link with no detail on what tasks can be delegated, how it operates agentically, or independent corroboration of its capabilities. missing for 10: detailed docs on task delegation/agentic actions Bits AI can perform, hands-on or community validation of its assistant behavior, and specifics on autonomy vs. simple Q&A.
